title: Selecting list positions
description: You can compare forward indices, a negative index and list length.

steps.description: snacks stores three strings. You select pretzels with index 0, the first position.
Index 2 selects popcorn. len reports three elements, counting all stored values.

steps.question: Does index -1 select the same element as index 2 here?
steps.answer: Yes. Both select popcorn, the last element of this three-element list.

steps.description: You see pretzels, popcorn, 3 and popcorn in order. The two indices reach the final element from different directions.
